static_traits.name: Kayla
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems in the past; no psychotherapy history; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness, can describe trigger situations and automatic thoughts concretely

basic_info.main_problem: Strong negative emotions and fear after losing a sale at work, tending to catastrophize and make negative predictions about the future (like worrying the family will have a terrible Christmas), leading to affected work performance, tense relationships with colleagues, and affected sleep and appetite.
basic_info.core_demands: Ongoing negative anticipation and catastrophizing about future events started affecting my mental health and work performance, which prompted me to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: The future will turn out terrible

special_situations.event: Losing a big order at work today
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I lose an order today, I will keep failing from then on, and it will affect the family's holidays and life
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to stay positive and focus on the next opportunity
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never close another deal again

special_situations.event: Quiet moments at lunch break, thinking alone after losing an order
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not stop these thoughts immediately, they will swallow me and make everything worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracts attention by walking or listening to music, preventing a negative thinking spiral
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: From now on, everything will go downhill

special_situations.event: Thinking of Christmas family expenses and income pressure, linked with losing an order that day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If performance declines, it will directly cause the family to have a bad Christmas
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Rehearses the worst case in advance to gain psychological preparation and control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This will make our Christmas terrible

special_situations.event: Positive evidence appears or is pointed out (for example, having lost an order then closing a bigger one the following week)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If positive results cannot last, they are not worth including in evaluation
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying or negating positive results, to maintain caution and risk vigilance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That was just luck, this time will not improve

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable, to gain stable work performance and life security
core_conflict.fear: Fear that failure lowers income, disappointing family and being negated by colleagues
defense_goal: Gaining a sense of control and psychological preparation by imagining the worst outcome in advance
Maintains high vigilance to avoid failing again

object_relations.self_representation: An employee prone to failure and judgment
object_relations.object_representation: Picky colleagues or clients who will negate him

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the realism of these negative predictions or asked to recall positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to see positive examples as mere luck, unable to change the overall trajectory (transference: seeing hope as unreliable)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle, supportive tone, first validating her emotions, then using concretizing follow-up questions to guide her to distinguish facts from speculation, encouraging her to list counterexamples and evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: After noticing others' emotions or gazes when interacting with colleagues
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing colleagues can all sense and negate his ability (transference: projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using clarification and boundary-setting questions, inviting distinction between fact and speculation; steady tone, not judgmental, encouraging concrete description of colleagues' actual words and actions.

manifestations: Making despairing predictions about the future after work setbacks ('everything will go downhill')
Treating a single failure as an overall worsening trend
Worries family holidays will turn bad; feels the prospects are gloomy

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly harsh on her own performance at work and magnifies negative results
Repeatedly reviewing himself inwardly after losing the deal and anticipating the worst
In interactions with colleagues, excessively cares about how others see them

exception_events.target_problem: After losing a sale, the client usually catastrophizes and predicts continued failure, causing low mood, scattered attention, and affected work performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: A few months ago, she lost a sale, but closed a bigger deal the following week; the outcome was markedly better than her prediction at the time.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: trying to stay positive and focus on following up the next opportunity; therefore this time a result different from past catastrophic anticipation appeared.

positive_force: Willing to stay positive and focus on the next opportunity
Able to recall and acknowledge past positive exceptions (after losing an order, closed a bigger order the next week)
Willing to try concrete strategies (recording positive outcomes, lunchtime walks/listening to music)
negative_force: Cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, predicting the future, and negating the positive
Fear of failure and negative anticipation of the future
Performance and income pressure causing overall increased stress levels
Sleep and appetite affected, lowering resilience
Tense relationships with colleagues, forming a negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing and extremely negative anticipation of the future after work setbacks, with anxiety and worry
antecedent: Quiet moments at lunch break easily slip into negative thinking
Performance and income pressure after losing orders several times in a row
target_behavior.core_reason: Excessively focuses on the consequences of failure and generalizes a single setback into persistent failure, predicting the family will therefore have a bad holiday and life
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential disappointment and uncertainty, trying to gain psychological control by rehearsing the worst case
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected, tense relationships with colleagues, sleep and appetite affected, overall mental health declined
